result.uncaughtBrowserExceptions: Every test asserts an empty pageerror list; no silent retry allowance.

absolutePositionSamplesAboveOneCssPx.case: a detail return marker runs the actual restore hook and consumes its session keys

measured.absolutePositionCaveat: The detail-return case has a 66px global fixed-height-reference difference while passing the separate existing viewport-alignment assertion. An estimated, unmeasured prefix is the likely cause; no claim that all restored absolute document coordinates are within 1px.
measured.scope: Retained coordinate attachments after settling; this is not a maximum across every frame or every assertCoverage call.
measured.anchorScope: Suite-wide numeric anchor deltas were not retained; thresholds are reported. The separate detail local-placement diagnostic below retains its alignment delta of 0.

supplementalDetailLocalPlacement.coordinateBasis: Row inline transform is produced from vi.start - scrollMargin; expected viewport top is root viewport top + that transform.

acceptanceClarification: The global fully-measured-prefix 1px target is not met or certified for the detail restoration (66px). Initial/warmed fixed-reference cases satisfy the scoped 1px assertions. Detail acceptance is complete viewport ID coverage, assigned virtual-row placement, and the existing 12vh + 8px viewport alignment within 2px; the separate recorded diagnostic has 0px local placement/alignment error.

assertions.completeViewportIdCoverage: All expected IDs present, overscan allowed.
assertions.coreReferencePositionCssPx: At most 1 for 390/820/1440 widths and initial upper offsets 0/180/3000.
assertions.readingAnchorCssPx: At most 2 for width changes, actual card layout changes, generation mismatch; late upper-height reader alignment additionally uses toBeCloseTo(..., 0), i.e. less than 0.5.
assertions.detailReturnAlignmentCssPx: At most 2 from the existing 12vh + 8px alignment.
assertions.topReaderScrollY: Exactly 0, including same-task return to top plus upper growth.
assertions.cancellationScrollYCssPx: At most 2 after the delayed page has committed at least 80 IDs and another 1000ms (URL/detail/middle), or 750ms (column/pending append).

limitations: Chromium viewport emulation; no physical mobile device, Safari, native scrollbar/autoscroll acceptance, or external media verification.
Geometry harness baseline supplies exact sizes and is independent of React/DOM/ResizeObserver integration.
Rows outside the viewport may be virtualized; viewport coverage is the criterion.
